details:
So, This is just an idea so that developers can think about it and MAYBE include it or something similar

Controller Players:
Controller players unlike K/M players have the ability to rotate objects (By pressing the right trigger/R2 and pressing the Left trigger/L2 and using the right analog stick) and to control the distance of the object (Using the left analog stick while grabbing something).
What is missing and needed for the Controller Players is a way to Adjust the sensitivity of the Camera, because you'll look like a tank when turning around.

Keyboard & Mouse Players (K/M):
Unlike Controller players, K/M users have more sensitivity in the camera movement and they have more control of the movement. What they miss is the ability to Rotate objects.

SOLUTION:

-Controller Players need a way to adjust the sensitivity (Already mentioned before), For example. In the System Menu instead of just a Tick in the Gamepad option it can be a clickable button that will display a window with the options to:
- Activate the Gamepad Input Support.
- Change camera sensitiviry (Can be a percentage bar).
- Change the buttons (For example, change the A/X button to be the jump button instead of the Y/Triangle).

-Keyboard and mouse players Can have by default the mouse Wheel button to turn on the "Rotation Mode" while grabbing an item. This item can be rotated with the Mouse movement and can be moved Forwards/Backwards with the W and S key, and also in the Systems menu, the kerboard option will be a button that will open a window with the options to:
- Activate Keyboard input Support
- Change Mouse camera sensitivity
- Change the keys (Example, instead of having the mouse wheel button for the rotation mode it can be changed to an extra mouse button at the side [ if your mouse has one ] ).

EXTRA MOVEMENT OPTIONS:

Crouching:
While crouching, the player will be at the 50% of his/her height and the camera will follow the eyes of the avatar (In this form, the avatar must be invisible to the player himself because with some fat avatars, the player's view might be covered up by the avatar itself)
By default, The Crouching button will be the Left Ctrl button on keyboard and the Right bumper Click/R3 on the controller.

Slow Movement:
While Slow movement is active, the player will go at 50% his/her movement speed. This option will only be for keyboard users because Controller users can adjust their walking speed with the left stick.
By default, Slow movement button will be the Left Alt key

That's it for now! hope you liked reading this Post and i hope something like this comes in the next update (Wouldn't mind being credited for it tho... [JK] ).

This community is my favourite one right now and i hope it still grows and gets better and better! Have a nice day!
title: MORE MOVEMENT OPTIONS FOR K&M / CONTROLLER PLAYERS
